contract.folds: lane A folds.json: inner_2019..inner_2023; selectors fit on each fold's train_rows [0, train_end) only; the fold's inner validation year is left untouched for FS-CLOSE paired refits

GROUP_GATE_K (lane B dependence clusters per fold)
CHRONOEPILOGI_K (official implementation if licence/pin/API verifiable, else faithful adapter with unreproduced scope marked; never called causal)

compute.chunking: one job per target, methods sequential inside the job, folds sequential
compute.inputs: ps1 features_train.parquet x3 + targets_train.parquet + folds.json relayed worker_a -> coordinator -> worker_b with ionice -c3 and sha256 verified both ends; lane B fold clusters taken from committed evidence
compute.outputs: ~/.local/state/canonical_20261003/fs_pred/ on worker_b: rankings per method x target x fold x K (parquet/jsonl with digests), selector_sets.json draft, progress.json; small tables + runner + unit files committed under fs_closure/fs_pred/

first_deliverable: tests (pure python, tiny) for identity/rejection/complete-ranking/RANDOM_K/group gate/refit invariants, then the extended campaign and batch runner committed; runner live on worker_b with its first completed method x target reported with counts, progress.json path and ETA

eta.completion: measured from the first completed target; published in progress.json and in the second report
